this_go_bounded_unusual_experiment.name: DUPLICATE_PACKAGE_PROVIDER_ROOT_ORDER_REVERSAL
this_go_bounded_unusual_experiment.treatment: Create two package roots claiming logical package clay.collision; resolve in [z,a] and [a,z] caller order.
this_go_bounded_unusual_experiment.epistemic_limit: This validates the duplicate-provider ordering mechanism only; it is not exact-head whole-resolver or self-hosted integration evidence.
this_go_bounded_unusual_experiment.rollback: Temporary directories only; no persistent runtime effect.

external_research_refresh.finding: Go resolves a package only when exactly one module in the build list provides it and reports an error when two or more provide it; this independently supports fail-closed ambiguity rather than root-order precedence.
external_research_refresh.promotion_limit: Clay does not copy Go module/version semantics; only the ambiguity invariant is retained.

grf_collapse.counter_reality_a: Its separate Clay.toml/path-derived package contract competes with the ClayEnv package identity architecture and its exact resolver gate was not yet observed on the accepted self-hosted lane.
grf_collapse.generated_reality_b: Reopen PR 638 immediately because it has 14/14 exact-head package-index evidence.
grf_collapse.counter_reality_b: PR 638 is stale/diverged by three product-main commits and immediate recomposition would touch clayenv/cli.py while active PR 644 also changes that surface, creating another collision.
grf_collapse.reason: Avoid a third same-surface collision. Keep both package prototypes closed, preserve their tests/invariants, and recompose exactly one canonical CM-07 package/import layer from fresh main after the current ClayEnv CLI trust-boundary change settles.

retained_invariants: Portable logical/package identity must not depend on absolute host root.
Duplicate package providers fail closed independent of discovery/root order.
Preserve MODULE versus WILDCARD use mode losslessly before symbol/linker semantics.
Resolved multi-module closure must feed the existing canonical checker -> executable TypedIR -> single ClayVM path, never a second execution architecture.
Exact-head self-hosted Linux/X64 evidence is required after recomposition.

targeted_reentry.note: Order-invariant duplicate-provider failure was routed back to the package-index lineage; no adoption of PR 639's separate manifest architecture was requested.
